rules.message: sql/queries.sql:1: SELECT can return every row of invoices; add a LIMIT, look rows up by a primary or unique key, or allow the table with a reason
sql/queries.sql:2: UPDATE can change every row of exports; pick the target rows in a CTE or subquery with a LIMIT, or match a primary or unique key
sql/queries.sql:4: SELECT can return every row of orders; add a LIMIT, look rows up by a primary or unique key, or allow the table with a reason
sql/queries.sql:5: SELECT can return every row of tokens; add a LIMIT, look rows up by a primary or unique key, or allow the table with a reason
